title: Hollow Knight
description: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes.

title: Hades
description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.

title: Disco Elysium
description: A groundbreaking role playing game. You are a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across.
